import copy, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.crosscheck import StreamEngine

FAILS = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILS.append(name); print('FAIL', name); print('  got ', json.dumps(got)[:500]); print('  want', json.dumps(want)[:500])
    else:
        print('pass', name)

SETTINGS = {"trials": 2, "epsilon": 0, "seed": 5, "cutoff": [0, 1], "bias": 0, "tau": 0,
            "gamma": [1, 1], "cache_slots": 2}

def run(topology, events, settings=None):
    stream = {"topology": topology, "settings": copy.deepcopy(settings or SETTINGS), "events": events}
    return StreamEngine(stream).replay(events)

def test_zero_capacity():
    topology = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 0},
                          {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 7}],
                "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 0}],
                "external_nodes": ["A", "B"]}
    events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 0], [1, 0, 5]], "counters": {
        "low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 0}, "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 0},
        "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 0}, "low_A_termination": {"perturbed": 0}}},
        {"op": "repair", "id": "z"}]
    answers = run(topology, events)
    check('zero cap links publish zero', answers[1]['links'],
          [[-1, 0, 0, 3, 1], [-1, 1, 0, 1, 1], [0, -1, 0, 3, 1], [0, 1, 0, 3, 1], [1, -1, 5, 1, 1], [1, 0, 0, 1, 1]])
    check('zero cap counter keys', sorted(answers[1]['counters']),
          ['low_A_egress_to_B', 'low_A_ingress_from_B', 'low_A_origination', 'low_A_termination',
           'low_B_egress_to_A', 'low_B_ingress_from_A', 'low_B_origination', 'low_B_termination'])
    reject = run(topology, [{"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 1}}}])
    check('zero cap rejects positive report', reject[0]['accepted'], False)
    reject = run(topology, [{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 1]]}])
    check('demand bound is global', reject[0]['accepted'], True)

def test_single_external_node():
    topology = {"nodes": [{"id": 3, "name": "Q", "external_capacity": 9}], "links": [],
                "external_nodes": ["Q"]}
    events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_Q_origination": {"perturbed": 2}}},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "s"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "s"}]
    answers = run(topology, events)
    check('single external flows', [link[:3] for link in answers[1]['links']], [[-1, 3, 2], [3, -1, 0]])
    check('single external order', answers[1]['order'], [[-1, 3], [3, -1]])
    check('single external validate', answers[2], {"op": "validate", "id": "s", "checked": 2,
                                                   "passed": 1, "consistent": False, "failed": ["low_Q_termination"]})

def test_isolated_router():
    topology = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 5},
                          {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 5},
                          {"id": 2, "name": "C", "external_capacity": 5}],
                "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 5}],
                "external_nodes": ["A", "B"]}
    events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 5]], "counters": {
        "low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 5}, "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 5},
        "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 5}, "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 5}}},
        {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": {"A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 1000}]},
                                                 "B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}]}}},
        {"op": "repair", "id": "i"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "i"}]
    answers = run(topology, events)
    # C is a nonexternal node: no origination/termination counters exist for it
    check('nonexternal keys absent', [k for k in answers[2]['counters'] if 'C' in k], [])
    check('checked count', answers[3]['checked'], 8)
    check('passed count', answers[3]['passed'], 8)

def test_fraction_cutoff():
    topology = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 10},
                          {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 10}],
                "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 10}],
                "external_nodes": ["A", "B"]}
    counters = {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 4}, "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 4},
                "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 4}, "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 4}}
    events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 4]], "counters": counters},
              {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": {"A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 1000}]},
                                                       "B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}]}}},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "c"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "c"}]
    answers = run(topology, events)
    confs = sorted({tuple(v['confidence']) for v in answers[2]['counters'].values()})
    print('confidences', confs)
    for cutoff, expected in [([1, 1], 8), ([2, 1], 0), ([1, 2], 8), ([3, 2], 0), ([5, 1], 0)]:
        settings = dict(SETTINGS, cutoff=cutoff)
        out = run(topology, events, settings)
        check('cutoff %s' % cutoff, (out[3]['checked'], out[3]['passed']),
              (expected, expected))

def main():
    test_zero_capacity()
    test_single_external_node()
    test_isolated_router()
    test_fraction_cutoff()
    print('failures', FAILS)
    return 1 if FAILS else 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
